Sam (Product): OK squad — we need to lock the cross-team constraints for the May pilot. Primary ask: customer needs private deployment + dedicated capacity + <150ms p95 for chat flows. What are the blockers?
Priya (Eng): main open items: runtime can hit p95 in hosted env but private has noisy neighbors risk. Need clear prewarm and tenant isolation plan.
Liam (Runtime): we can reach p95 with prefix caching + smaller batch size, but that raises unit cost. Suggest gating: canary 10% traffic -> measure tail latencies for 48h. Also need KV cache warmup script.
Olivia (Infra): staging window: we only have a reserved 4-GPU pool the week of May 10. If pilot wants 10x burst we need approval. Options: (a) reserve extra GPUs for pilot (costy) or (b) do phased rollout with scaled concurrency.
Marcus (Security): note: customer requires KMS/HSM integration and audit logs enabled before private pilot. That is non-negotiable. HSM cert exchange takes ~3 weeks with vendor. We should flag as a launch gate.
Ben (SRE): agree with Marcus. Also want a rollback playbook for model fallback to lighter quantized variant. Example snippet we discussed in runbook:
```
if p95 > 200ms for 5m -> route % traffic to quant-8 variant and alert on-call
```
Sam (Product): ok so acceptance criteria draft: p95 < 150ms in private pilot for canonical prompts, KMS/HSM integrated and audited, canary telemetry for 48h, rollback plan documented. Anything missing?
Priya (Eng): add quality guard: Rouge/semantic eval on a small prompt set must not regress >2% from baseline. Redwood Optimize team will own metric.
Liam (Runtime): timeline: KV cache warmup script + canary routing code -> 1.5 engineer-weeks. Need infra to provision prewarm nodes.
Olivia (Infra): can provision prewarm nodes if we get capacity sign-off from finance. If not approved, we can timebox a phased concurrency ramp: max_concurrency 8 -> 32 over 72h.
Marcus (Security): to unblock vendor HSM we need PO & legal T&Cs signed. I'll start the T&C intake today — ETA 15 business days.
Sam (Product): decisions for this thread: 1) Mark HSM/KMS integration as hard launch gate. 2) Approve canary 10% for 48h. 3) Use phased concurrency ramp if extra GPUs not approved. Action owners: Priya -> runtime canary + rollback, Olivia -> capacity request to finance, Marcus -> HSM intake, Ben -> create runbook.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: staging/prewarm job queued for 2026-05-06 03:00 UTC (depends on infra approval). :gear:
Priya (Eng): noted. I'll open a short PR with the canary config and a README for rollback steps by EOW.
Sam (Product): thanks — we'll reconvene Wed 10am PT to validate prewarm metrics and finalize launch checklist. :thumbsup:
